name.value: Locals Restaurant at the Old House

description.value: Locals Restaurant at the Old House is a west coast fine dining destination housed in a 1921 heritage cedar-and-masonry building alongside the Puntledge River in Courtenay, BC. The kitchen draws exclusively from Comox Valley farms, fields, and coastline, rotating themed nightly specials around local seafood, butchery, and seasonal produce. Cyclists can take in river views from the dining room or, in warmer months, from the open-air patio or covered wooden deck.
